skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — convert this blog intro into a 30-second video with visuals and voiceover...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Text to Video Converter AI.
- Instantly turn written text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, SRT up to 200MB) into shareable videos with visuals and voiceover.
- Simple workflow: upload or describe content, get an AI-generated video (MP4 or other formats) in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session management, including free starter credits for new users.
- Includes status indicators, upload support, export/download options, and credit balance checks.
- Designed for users without editing experience—skip the learning curve of traditional video tools.
